title.narrative: Guinea - Economic and Financial Reform Support Program - PAREF
Guinée - Programme d’appui aux réformes économiques et financières (PAREF)

description.narrative: Le PAREF a pour but global de contribuer à la création des conditions nécessaires à la relance économique et au rétablissement de la stabilité macroéconomique. Ses objectifs spécifiques sont (i) le renforcement de la gestion des finances publiques et (ii) l'amélioration de la gouvernance dans le secteur extractif.

PAREF’s goal is to contribute to creating the necessary conditions for economic recovery and macroeconomic stability. Its specific objectives are: (i) strengthening of public finance management; and (ii) improvement of governance in the extractive sector.

Le bénéficiaire final du programme est la population guinéenne dans son ensemble. Celle-ci profitera de l’amélioration du niveau de vie qui résultera de la mise en œuvre de politiques de réduction de la pauvreté, d’un meilleur accès aux services sociaux et d’infrastructure de base ainsi que d’une relance économique génératrice d’emplois et de revenus. Les bénéficiaires intermédiaires sont : les administrations publiques, qui bénéficieront de nouvelles procédures et nouveaux cadre réglementaires pour exercer leurs missions ; les opérateurs économiques privés nationaux et internationaux qui opéreront dans un environnement des affaires amélioré par des législations plus cohérentes et répondant aux standards internationaux et ; les communautés vivant autour des bassins miniers qui profiteront d’une nouvelle politique publique d’exploitation minière protégeant leurs intérêts et améliorant leurs conditions de vie.

The end programme beneficiary is the Guinean population in general, which will enjoy improved standard of living resulting from the implementation of poverty reduction policies, better access to social services and basic infrastructure, employment and income-generating economic recovery. The intermediate beneficiaries are: public departments, which will have new procedures and regulatory frameworks to fulfil their missions; national and international private operators which will operate in an improved business environment made possible by the enactment of coherent legislation of international standards and; communities living around the mining basins that will benefit from a new mining operational policy that protects their interests and improves their living conditions.

La présente intervention est relative au Programme d’appui aux réformes économiques et financières (PAREF). Il vise à appuyer le budget de l’état afin de permettre au Gouvernement de mettre en œuvre le DSRP mais également le plan d’investissement d’urgence relatif à la fourniture de services sociaux et d’infrastructure de base à la population. Le PAREF est nécessaire pour permettre au Gouvernement de rétablir la stabilité macroéconomique et disposer de marge budgétaire afin de mettre en place sa stratégie de réduction de la pauvreté. Pour cela des réformes structurantes portant sur le renforcement de la gestion budgétaire et sur l'amélioration de la contribution du secteur extractif au développement sont des priorités immédiates pour le nouveau Gouvernement. Le programme s’articule autour de deux composantes principales, (i) le renforcement de la gestion des finances publiques et (ii) l’amélioration de la gouvernance dans le secteur extractif. Les objectifs visés par les deux composantes se complètent. En effet, alors que la première vise à améliorer la gestion des ressources publiques, la seconde vise à alimenter ces ressources par une meilleure contribution du secteur extractif à l’économie.

This intervention concerns the Economic and Financial Reform Support Programme (PAREF). It seeks to support the government budget to enable it to implement the PRSP as well as the emergency investment plan for providing social services and basic infrastructure to the population. PAREF is necessary to enable the Government to restore macroeconomic stability and have the fiscal space to put in place its poverty reduction strategy. To this end, structuring reforms on enhanced budget management and improved contribution by the extractive sector to development are immediate priorities for the new Government. The programme consists of two main components: (i) strengthening public finance management; and (ii) improving governance in the extractive sector. The objectives of the two components are complementary. The former seeks to improve the management of public resources while the latter aims to sustain these resources through better contribution by the extractive sector to the economy.

Validation by the Cabinet Meeting of a bill to revise the Mining Code

target.value: Bill to revise the Mining Code is validated by the Cabinet Meeting before end-July 2011

actual.value: A new Mining Code was adopted by the National Transition Council on 9 September 2011. It replaces the 1995 Code.

target.value: Guinea’s EITI status as suspended member in 2008 changed to EITI compliant member in 2011

actual.value: Although the suspension was lifted in March 2011, the country is still not compliant with international EITI standards

title.narrative: Design of an action plan for mining contracts audit pursuant to the laws in force

target.value: The action plan for mining contracts audit is validated by the Ministry of Mines and Geology before end-2011

actual.value: An action plan for the revision of mining agreements has been adopted.

title.narrative: Validation by MEF of an action plan for the opening of a single Treasury account in the Central Bank

target.value: Action plan for the opening of a single Treasury account is validated by the Ministry of the Economy and Finance before end-2011

actual.value: An action plan to create a single Treasury account was validated. This activity benefited from IMF technical assistance.

title.narrative: Inventory of public institutions’ accounts in commercial banks

target.value: Inventory of public institutions’ accounts in all commercial banks finalized before end-March 2011

actual.value: An inventory of public institutions’ accounts in commercial banks was conducted.

title.narrative: Conduct of audits member in 2011 (FY 2007 and following) required for implementation of Guinea’s EITI plan of action

target.value: FY 2007, 2008, 2009 and 2010 audit reports prepared before end-2011

actual.value: Audit reports of financial flows in FY 2007 to 2010 were prepared and published.

title.narrative: Issuance by MEF of an order governing the use of exceptional budget execution procedures: (i) expenditure without prior authorization and (ii) advance controls

target.value: Order of MEF governing the use of exceptional budget execution procedures is issued before end-March 2011

actual.value: Order No. 1084 was signed by MEF on 18 March 2011. This Order governs the use of exceptional State budget execution procedures. It defines three exceptional execution categories: (i) payment before liquidation, (ii) payments without corresponding prior authorization, and (iii) payments by advance system.

title.narrative: Signing of performance contracts between the Ministry of the Economy and Finance and State revenue services: National Tax Directorate (DNI) and National Customs Directorate (DND)

target.value: Performance contracts between the Ministry of the Economy and Finance and DND are signed before end-July 2011

actual.value: Performance contracts were signed between the Ministry-delegate of the Budget and State revenue services (National Tax Directorate and General Directorate of Customs).

title.narrative: Conduct of quarterly procedures audits and financial audits on public contracts for FY 2009 and FY 2010 by the General Inspectorate of Finance

target.value: Quarterly procedures and financial audits of public contracts for FY 2009 and 2010 conducted before end-2011

actual.value: Quarterly audits of public procurements for FY 2009 and 2010 were conducted by IGF. The audits were conducted and published with the financial support of the World Bank.

title.narrative: Update of the General Tax Code

target.value: Update of the General Tax Code is validated by the Ministry of the Economy and Finance before end-2011

actual.value: The General Tax Code was not updated. This planned activity (financing by PARCGEF) fell behind the initial schedule due to the late start-up of PARCGEF.

title.narrative: Validation by the Cabinet Meeting of the bill on the new Petroleum Code

target.value: Bill on the new Petroleum Code is validated by the Cabinet Meeting before end-2011

actual.value: The Oil and Gas Code has not yet been prepared. This planned activity to be financed by PARCGEF fell behind schedule because of the late start-up of the project.

title.narrative: Validation by MEF of an action plan for finalizing delayed Audited Budget Laws

target.value: The action plan is validated before end-2011

actual.value: The action plan for preparing the Audited Finance Bill, delayed since 2005, has not been prepared

title.narrative: Validation by the Cabinet Meeting of the bill governing the award, regulation of public contracts and delegation of public services

target.value: Bill governing the award, control and regulation of public contracts and delegation of public services is validated by the Cabinet Meeting before end-July 2011

actual.value: The bill laying down general principles of public procurement and delegation of public services was adopted in Cabinet Meeting.

title.narrative: Transmission of Organic Bill on the institutional organization of the Court of Auditors to the National Transition Council (CNT)

target.value: The Organic Bill on the institutional organization of the Court of Auditors is transmitted to the National Transition Council before end-March 2011

actual.value: The draft Organic Law specifying the duties, organization and operation of the Court of Auditors is being considered at CNT.

title.narrative: Update of the financial control procedures manual to align it to international standards

target.value: Financial control procedures manual is updated before end-2011

actual.value: The financial control procedures manual was not updated

title.narrative: Adoption by the Cabinet Meeting of an action plan to implement the negotiated contract audit recommendations

target.value: The action plan to implement negotiated contract audit recommendations is validated by the Cabinet Meeting before end-2011

actual.value: The implementation of the FY 2009 and 2010 procurement audit recommendations (measure 1.c.1) was seen in the creation of a commission to pay public procurements granted in 2009 and 2010, based on an order of the Prime Minister.

title.narrative: Conduct of an independent audit on the legality and transparency of negotiated contracts granted in 2009 and 2010

target.value: Audit of the legality and transparency of negotiated contracts awarded in 2009 and 2010, by an independent commission before end-March 2011

actual.value: The independent audit on the legality and transparency of public contracts granted in 2009 and 2010 was conducted.
